query: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO workspace_user_invite_role(invite_id, workspace_id, role_id, scope_id) SELECT $1, $2, UNNEST($3::UUID[]), UNNEST($4::UUID[]) ON CONFLICT (invite_id, role_id, scope_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING role_id, scope_id) SELECT role_permission.permission_id AS "permission_id!", inserted.scope_id AS "scope_id!" FROM inserted INNER JOIN role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = inserted.role_id;
